DraftLens EDU — Simple Controlled DXF Test Pack

Reference characteristics:
- Units: centimeters
- 19 model-space entities
- 16 LINE
- 1 CIRCLE
- 2 closed LWPOLYLINE
- All entities on Layer 0
- Every individual LINE is exactly 100 units long
- No exact duplicate entities in the reference
- No zero-length entities
- No unsupported geometry in the reference

Run tests in this order:

00_reference_000-Simple.dxf
Use as the instructor reference for every test.

01_exact_copy_should_score_100.dxf
Expected: 100 or the system's documented maximum; zero geometry issues.
This is the critical false-positive gate. Do not continue if it fails.

02_missing_line_73B.dxf
One isolated horizontal LINE is deleted.
Expected: one missing-geometry issue at the upper-left isolated horizontal line.

03_wrong_length_73C_80_units.dxf
One isolated vertical LINE is shortened from 100 to 80 units.
Expected: inaccurate length, expected-versus-actual evidence, localized highlight.

04_moved_line_73B_plus20Y.dxf
One isolated horizontal LINE is moved upward 20 units without changing length.
Expected: positional inaccuracy, not a length error.

05_wrong_angle_73D_40deg.dxf
One isolated diagonal LINE changes from 30 degrees to 40 degrees, retaining 100-unit length.
Expected: angular inaccuracy with expected-versus-actual geometry.

06_moved_circle_722_plus20X.dxf
The circle moves 20 units right without changing radius.
Expected: positional inaccuracy for the circle.

07_wrong_circle_radius_40.dxf
The circle radius changes from 50 to 40 units.
Expected: radius inaccuracy with measurement evidence.

08_extra_line_handle_740.dxf
One isolated 100-unit horizontal LINE is added.
Expected: one extra-geometry issue.

09_duplicate_line_73B_handle_741.dxf
The isolated upper-left horizontal LINE is duplicated exactly.
Expected: duplicate/extra-entity issue without crashing.

10_disconnected_square_corner_5_units.dxf
The lower endpoint of the square's right vertical side is shortened by 5 units.
Expected: connectivity issue plus a 5-unit length discrepancy. This is intentionally a combined case.

Audit rule:
Record expected result, actual score, issue count, issue category, highlighted location,
feedback usefulness, deduction, browser console error, and pass/fail for every file.
